title: Kelowna: Morning Discount Parasailing Experience
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Okanagan Parasail is a family owned and operated business that is dedicated to providing you with the best experience possible. Come fly with us hundreds of feet over Lake Okanagan for the ride that will make your summer. Enjoy the spectacular views of Kelowna and the Okanagan Valley and wave to your friends below.
